collateralizationRatio.rationale: The XAI mint module was deprecated by SiloDAO governance in 2024 and credit lines were burned; the residual 5,358,653.23 XAI supply at block 25627256 is wind-down remnant (un-repaid legacy borrows and stranded liquidity), not a live CDP system. evidenceSummary: XAI is a deprecated stablecoin in wind-down, not a live CDP. Pinned primary evidence: (1) SiloDAO governance thread 443, announced 2024-01-17 and executed 2024-04-22 — XAI credit lines retracted and burned across 17 silos, borrow APRs raised to force repayment, mint module deprecated so no more XAI can be minted. (2) On-chain reads of the XAI token 0xd7C9F0e536dC865Ae858b0C0453Fe76D13c3bEAc at Ethereum block 25627256 (2026-07-27T22:52:23Z, ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com): totalSupply() = 5,358,653.226231736 XAI (residual wind-down supply), decimals 18, name 'XAI Stablecoin', and paused() (0x5c975abb) reverts — the token has no pausable pause-state getter. (3) Neither docs.silo.finance nor devdocs.silo.finance indexes mention XAI anymore (llms.txt checked 2026-07-27). Measuring collateralization or liquidation capacity over the residual debt of a deprecated module would be mechanism-meaningless and was not attempted. A lifecycle ruling for this asset (deprecation handling vs. overlay) belongs to the morning coordinator.
